title: Vomiting, diarrhea or dehydration
summary: Vomiting, diarrhea, fluid losses or low intake. Dehydration is considered according to context and a gastrointestinal illness according to symptoms. An isolated urine reading (color, pH, salinity) does not quantify hydration. Informational support only: not a diagnosis or a treatment decision. There are no clinical personnel on board: the steps are first aid and monitoring; treatment depends on mission procedures.

immediate.text: Vomiting or diarrhea with new confusion, loss of consciousness or blood in the vomit: emergency.
notify: mission control (if the link is up)

steps.text: Call for emergency help now using the mission's means (ship alarm, crew, mission control if the link is up). Do not wait to see if it improves.

prompt_review.text: You cannot keep fluids down, you are urinating little, or the symptoms persist: rehydrate carefully and monitor closely.
notify: mission control (if the link is up)

steps.text: Take small sips of water often.
If there is oral rehydration solution or an electrolyte drink in the medical kit, use it.
If confusion, fainting, no urine output, a rapid pulse or rapid breathing appears, treat it as an emergency.

missing_guidance: Antiemetics and intravenous fluids: depend on the mission procedure (not loaded).

review.text: Vomiting or diarrhea without warning signs: drink, and monitor whether you can keep fluids down and how much you urinate.
notify: mission control (if the link is up)

steps.text: Drink more fluids; if you have trouble keeping them down, take small sips.
If confusion, fainting, no urine output, a rapid pulse or rapid breathing appears, treat it as an emergency.

fluids_check.text: To decide the priority, it is still unknown whether you can keep fluids down and how much you have urinated.
notify: mission control (if the link is up)

steps.text: Check whether you can keep fluids down and whether you have urinated in the last few hours.

questions.fluids_urine: Can you keep fluids down, and have you urinated normally in the last few hours?

candidates.label: Dehydration
candidates.minimum_evidence: Reported losses (vomiting, diarrhea, heavy sweating), low intake or scant urine.
